findings.detail: Balance holds. (a) carries TWO uncancelled Q151 aggravations on distinct heads: H1 (senior aide the whole team models — person of eminency whose example is likely followed) AND H4 (public, before six copying trainees + two waiting family — the act teaches contempt to watchers). Its H3 is genuinely lighter (single outburst) and the same-day apology is a MITIGATION that does not cancel H1/H4. (b) carries H2 (great-aunt who raised her — specially-related, and a defenseless dementia patient) AND H3 (year-long continuance). Strongest 'b worse' case: settled year-long cruelty to a defenseless specially-owed dependent. Strongest 'a worse' case: a team-model publicly corrupting six trainees who will replicate it, defiling the shop's practice at scale. Neither strictly dominates: (a)'s H1+H4 are uncancelled and reach many; (b)'s H2+H3 are uncancelled and reach depth. Incomparable stands.

This item's head-pair mold — (a) H1+H4 public-example-follower + single-repented act vs (b) H2 specially-related + H3 continuance — is IDENTICAL to accepted s6 item CONT-N-019 (youth sports, C6: public example-setting head coach vs privately-cruel-to-the-orphan-ward-he-promised-to-protect). Same commandment family (C6 word-cruelty), same head-pair, same 'defenseless specially-obligated ward' construction. It is CONT-N-019 relocated from youth sports to eldercare. Not a kill (setting differs; brief permits mold reuse across sessions), but flag for MONOTONY at the wave level.
findings.proposed_fix: Acceptable as-is; if Fable wants variety, swap (b)'s aggravation stack to a different head-pair (e.g., H2 + H4-place) so the batch does not lean 4x on H1+H4-vs-H2+H3.

findings.detail: Setting substantially duplicates s6 CONT-N-021 (home-health agency sending aides into elderly clients' homes, C6). Both are home-health/eldercare agencies disciplining two aides for C6 offenses. The offense TYPE differs (021 = neglect/presumption; 023 = word-cruelty) so the item is not a mechanical duplicate, but the framing sentence is near-verbatim ('I run a home-health agency that sends aides into elderly clients homes').
findings.proposed_fix: Re-skin the setting to a hospice-nursing-home or adult-daycare so the opening line does not echo CONT-N-021's near-verbatim frame; the head-analysis is unaffected.

findings.detail: This is the strongest-balanced item in the batch and the ONLY one where both sides carry TWO substantive uncancelled loads. (a): H1 (ordained lead Bible teacher, example followed) + H4 (classroom before copying children, place aggravates) + H3-lite (day-after-day habit) — over a LIGHTER kind (careless filler, per the stem's own label). (b): H3 the graver KIND (express profane cursing of the name) + H3 persistence-after-admonition (brushed off correction, persists secretly). The trade is real: kind-of-the-sin + persistence-after-reproof (b) vs office + worship-forming setting + example-to-children (a). Neither dominates. Good use of the stem-label device to fix the kind-classification for a mid-tier grader.

Doctrine is sound. C3/Q113 ('vain, irreverent, profane use and abusing') and Q112 correctly cited; H1/H4 mapping is accurate. The stem-label reliance is disclosed in a GRADER NOTE so no independent theological classification is demanded — this is the right move for gradeability.

Balance holds — near-twin of CONT-N-023 in structure but for C8 theft. (a): H1 (lead foreman apprentices imitate) + H4 (open theft before the copying crew — teaches the trade includes it) both uncancelled; flat confession + same-day restitution are MITIGATIONS (Q142 remedy) that do NOT cancel H1/H4. (b): H2 (benefactor who hired him as a favor to a dying brother, set him up, lent rent — ingratitude aggravates) + H3 (year-long careful padding). Strongest 'a worse': public example normalizing theft crew-wide. Strongest 'b worse': sustained ingratitude-theft from a specially-obligated benefactor. Neither strictly dominates.

Same head-pair mold as CONT-N-023 (H1+H4 public-example-follower + single-repented vs H2 specially-related + H3 continuance). CONT-N-023, 025, 027, 031 all run this identical mold; only the commandment and setting rotate. At batch level this is 4/9 on one mold. Not individually killable but the wave-level review should note the mold concentration.
findings.proposed_fix: Optional: shift (b) in one of the four to an H4-place aggravation instead of H2-relation to break the four-fold H2-vs-H4 repetition.

findings.detail: DOMINANCE RISK: (b) plausibly strictly dominates (a). Side (a)'s aggravation profile is thin — the key itself concedes 'H1 light-to-moderate (a floor tech, not a leader others model themselves on — the public reach comes from the setting, not his office)' and 'H3 light — a one-time performance ... admitted afterward as puffery.' So (a) rests on essentially ONE uncancelled head: H4 (public). Side (b) stacks THREE distinct uncancelled loads: H3 year-long continuance + H3 persistence-after-admonition (false assurance to the clerk, then concealed harder) + the helpless-trusting-widow quality-of-offence aggravation. A grader building the strongest Standards case can argue (b) carries strictly more, and more uncancelled, aggravation than (a) on every axis except public reach — and (a)'s public reach is puffery admitted as mitigation. When one side has 1 uncancelled head over a repented act and the other has 3 uncancelled loads, a confident 'b is worse' total order becomes defensible, and gold=decline then punishes the correct answer. This is the exact s6 killer shape (mitigation-loaded side vs multi-aggravator side).
findings.proposed_fix: Rebalance (a) upward so it carries a genuine SECOND uncancelled head to offset (b)'s three loads. Make the (a) tech a shift-lead / senior service-writer the junior techs model (restore a real H1), so (a) = H1 (example-follower) + H4 (public before crowd AND copying juniors) vs (b)'s H2/quality + H3 + persistence. Retain the after-the-fact admission as mitigating texture. This makes the two-uncancelled-heads-each requirement (HARD RULE 1) actually hold and defeats the (b)-dominates case.

findings.detail: DOMINANCE RISK: (b) plausibly dominates. (a) = H1 (VP the neighborhood models) + H4 (public block-party pass before neighbors/children) — two heads, BUT over a single episode met next-morning with shame + intent to apologize (mitigation-loaded). (b) = H2 sacred-near relation (daughter-in-law / son's wife — Q139 'incest', the gravest relational aggravation available) + H3 year continuance + H3 persistence-after-admonition (swore he'd stop, concealed harder). (b) carries THREE uncancelled loads, one of which (incest-near relation under Q139) is among the heaviest single aggravations in the entire Q139 catalogue, PLUS obstinacy-after-reproof. Against a single repented public pass, the strongest Standards case that 'b is worse' is quite strong: sustained incestuously-near adultery persisted-in after warning arguably outweighs a one-off publicly-witnessed verbal pass. The incommensurability is not secure because (b)'s incest-near + persistence stack is heavier in kind than (a)'s public-single-act. Kill-adjacent; repairable by dialing (b) down or (a) up.
findings.proposed_fix: Reduce (b)'s dominance: either (i) drop the persistence-after-admonition from (b) so it is H2+H3-continuance ONLY (not H2+H3+obstinacy-after-reproof — three loads is what tips it), OR (ii) strengthen (a) to a completed act with ongoing public fallout (e.g., the pass became a known neighborhood scandal actively corrupting the watching teens' conduct) so H4's reach is sustained, not a single closed episode. Either edit restores a defensible two-way incomparability.

findings.detail: Balance holds. (a): H1 (ordained clinical director whose example the staff models AND who actively draws a cohort in — occasioning others' sin) + H4 (deliberate collision with the worship-service time, displacing a cohort from worship) + H3 (fixed weekly). (b): H3 obstinate continuance + H3 persistence-after-admonition (promised to stop, then hid it) — but purely her own, corrupting no one. Strongest 'a worse': an office-holder leading a whole cohort of new hires away from worship weekly (the leading-others-astray aggravation is heavy). Strongest 'b worse': obstinate admonition-defying settled profanation with a broken promise. (a)'s draws-others-in + worship-collision is a genuinely heavy pair that (b) cannot match; (b)'s obstinacy-after-reproof is genuinely heavy in the continuance head. Neither dominates. Good C4 item; doctrine (Q117-119, Q151 H1 occasioning + H4 time) accurate.

The parenthetical 'Genuine works of necessity and mercy in hospice care are not in view here — both cases concern ordinary, optional, non-urgent activity by free choice' is a stem clarification, NOT a hedge, and does not telegraph the decline. It is legitimate and necessary to foreclose the works-of-mercy escape hatch that C4 hospice settings invite. No LEAK; noting for completeness that it survives HARD RULE 3/5 scrutiny.

DOMINANCE RISK (mirror-inverted): here (a) is the obstinate side and (b) is the public-repented side, but the imbalance is the same shape as 026/027. (a): H3 obstinate year-long continuance + H3 persistence-after-REPEATED admonition (relapsing after being spoken to twice, plainly means to keep it) — the key calls this 'the gravest form of the continuance head' — against defenseless customers he preys on. (b): H1 (shop star apprentices copy) + H4 (public front-counter advance before waiting room + apprentices) over a SINGLE incident met same-day with self-disgust (mitigation-loaded). Strongest 'a worse' case: obstinate, twice-warned, ongoing predation that WILL NOT STOP is arguably graver than a one-off repented public advance — the key's own language ('gravest form of the continuance head', 'plainly will not stop by talking') builds the (a)-dominates case for the grader. When the key itself calls one side's aggravation 'the gravest form', the incomparability is undercut. Defensible total order (a>b) is reachable.
findings.proposed_fix: Soften the key's superlative framing ('gravest form of the continuance head' → 'a heavy continuance aggravation') AND give (b) a second sustained edge so its H1+H4 is not purely single-episode: e.g., the shop-star's advance became a known incident the apprentices now joke about / imitate, so H4's corrupting reach persists past the single moment. That restores parity against (a)'s obstinate-predation stack. Alternatively drop 'relapsing again and again after I've spoken to him TWICE' to a single prior warning to reduce (a)'s persistence weight.

findings.detail: Balance holds — the C2 analogue of 028. (a): H1 (teaching elder the congregation follows AND draws the whole assembly into will-worship — occasioning the entire church) + H4 (in public Lord's Day worship, corrupting the assembly's worship — place+time aggravates) + H3 (fixed weekly). (b): H3 obstinate private continuance + H3 persistence-after-admonition (said she'd stop, became secretive), but touches no one else. (a)'s leading-the-whole-assembly-into-image-veneration-in-public-worship is genuinely heavy and wide; (b)'s obstinate-after-reproof private syncretism is genuinely heavy in kind (express image-worship + folk syncretism, Q109). Neither dominates: (a) wins on scope/office/occasioning, (b) on obstinacy-after-reproof-in-a-graver-private-kind. Incomparable stands. Doctrine (Q109, WCF 21.1 regulative principle, H1 occasioning + H4 place/time) accurate.

DOMINANCE RISK: same shape as 027. (a) = H1 (dean of students the staff models) + H4 (single message publicized on a shared screen before a roomful) over a SINGLE act admitted within the hour with horror (mitigation-loaded). (b) = H2 (wife of his own close friend of many years — near relation/loyalty breached) + H3 year continuance + H3 persistence-after-admonition (promised to stop, concealed harder). (b) again stacks THREE uncancelled loads vs (a)'s two-heads-over-a-repented-single-act. UNLIKE 027, (b)'s relation here is 'close friend's wife', which is a weaker relational aggravation than 027's incest-near daughter-in-law — so the imbalance is milder — but combined with year-continuance + persistence-after-reproof, a grader can still build a defensible 'b is worse' order (sustained betrayal of a friend's marriage, persisted-in after warning, vs one publicized-then-retracted message). The single-message-with-shared-screen-accident also weakens (a): it was 'before he could pull it back', i.e. semi-accidental publicity, further thinning H4's culpable weight.
findings.proposed_fix: Two fixes needed: (i) remove the 'accidental publicity' framing — make (a)'s public element deliberate (he SAID it aloud / sent it knowing others would see) so H4 is a culpable public act, not an accident that lands publicly; (ii) either drop (b)'s persistence-after-admonition OR strengthen (a) to a sustained public fallout. Currently (a)'s only two heads are both softened (single act + accidental publicity + within-hour admission) while (b) carries three firm loads — the clearest (b)-dominates case among the C7 trio after 027.
